findings.label: Unregistered-phone SMS-bomb gap now closed
findings.detail: The prior OTP-login review's defense-in-depth gap is resolved: RequestOTP now runs the cooldown and max-per-window checks BEFORE the user lookup and stores a code for any phone+role, so an unregistered phone increments the per-phone+role counters and trips ErrOTPRateLimited. Verified in code and by TestRequestOTPUnknownPhoneSendsCodeAndRateLimits. No action required; recorded to confirm closure.

findings.label: Non-constant-time OTP hash comparison (pre-existing, out of scope)
findings.detail: VerifyOTP compares the computed code hash to the stored hash with != rather than subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. This is unchanged from the base OTP-login commit (270e1bd) and not touched by this diff; low risk (keyed sha256). Noted only for continuity, not introduced here.
